objective: Replay all 100 frozen exact-binary H67 ep35 FC1 activation records through the unmodified official Prosperity CPU Simulator.run_fc path and compare its product-sparsity mode with its bit-sparsity mode under one identical official configuration.

population.stage3_exclusion: Stage-3 FC1 is absent from the M51 exact-binary set because its input is nonbinary; it must not be synthesized, binarized, padded into the population, or represented by stage-3 FC2.

mapping.frozen_layout: C_ORDER [T,B,H,W,C] with little-bit packing within each byte
mapping.official_internal_row_order: Simulator.run_fc reshapes [T,B*H*W,K], then permutes to [B*H*W,T,K]; effective row order is b,h,w,t and K remains input-channel order.
mapping.padding: K and N are exact multiples of 16 and 128 for this population. Partial M tiles use the official cur_tile_size_M and do not inject synthetic active rows. Report physical tile padding separately.

exact_n_tile_expansion.method: Call the official CPU run_fc once at one complete N=128 tile for every record and mode, scale all repeated N-tile counters by exact N/128, then recompute the official one-time initial-memory and overlapped middle-memory latency equations.
exact_n_tile_expansion.proof_condition: All FC1 N values are exact multiples of 128 and both the primitive and full-N operators select the same single-weight-tile buffer state because the official weight SRAM is exactly one 16x128x8 tile.

fail_closed: Abort on any contract, manifest, receipt, docs359, official commit, official cleanliness, official source SHA, selected payload SHA/size/popcount/tail, module population, sample population, shape, weight K/N identity, binary predicate, mapping, or exact-expansion mismatch.
Do not modify the official Prosperity repository.
Do not divide official M618 cycles by M481 or any in-house cycle model.
Do not label the external artifact mechanism, cycles, speedup, energy, PPA, or full-network result as ours.
A full 100-record author run remains a development result until a fresh independent M619 review admits it.
